Subject: CAIQ matrix consolidation + evidence upload plan for SterlingTech

Hi Kimberly / Marissa,

Thanks again for the quick intro last week. Our compliance team at SterlingTech has asked for a consolidated CAIQ (Cloud Assurance Initiatives Questionnaire) response and a short runnable plan for evidence submission. Specific asks from our side:

- A CAIQ-to-control mapping (CSV or Excel) showing Redwood claims mapped to CSA controls (control IDs).
- Representative evidence stubs for runtime telemetry, keystore rotation, and tenant isolation (prefer short log excerpts or file names).
- An upload destination (SFTP/secure upload or DocuSign for attestations) and an estimated timeline for delivery.
- Point of contact at Redwood who will own each bundle (technical owner + legal/compliance contact).

Can you confirm scope (we only need coverage for runtime + key management + data residency controls for now) and an ETA? Marco from SecPartners is looped in to help validate.

I've attached the Sterling request matrix for reference (small spreadsheet).

Thanks,
Alyssa Ng
Head of Compliance
SterlingTech

Attachment: sterling_caiq_request_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet - referenced, not uploaded here)

Hi Alyssa — thanks for the clear list. Scope and next steps below.

Scope confirmed: runtime telemetry, keystore rotation, tenant isolation / tenancy boundaries, and retention-related provenance for those areas. We will provide:

- Single consolidated CAIQ mapping (Excel): control ID, Redwood assertion, evidence artifact name, internal owner.
- Evidence stubs: short log extracts (masked), keystore rotation key IDs + rotation schedule PDF, a tenant isolation architecture diagram (PDF), and a sample retention/ingest trace.
- Delivery method: secure upload to our protected Drive link (pre-signed, 30d expiry) + DocuSign attestation for the CAIQ narrative if your legal team requires signature.
- Owners: Technical owner: Marissa Cole (marissa_cole); Compliance/attestation owner: Kimberly Park (kimberly_park).

ETA: initial mapping + stub list by Wed 2026-06-10 EOD PT; evidence bundle (zipped stubs) by Fri 2026-06-12 pending any additional redaction requests. If Marco needs a validation review prior to upload we can carve out Thu morning for a quick walkthrough.

I've attached the first-pass CAIQ mapping (v0.1) and a short evidence index we plan to deliver.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Senior Manager, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood_caiq_mapping_v0.1.xlsx; evidence_index_sterling_v0.1.md

Thanks, Kimberly — looks good. A couple of quick clarifications from our validation checklist:

1) For keystore rotation: please include the sample key metadata (key ID, algorithm, last rotation timestamp) and the KMS audit event ID(s) for a rotation action (you can mask the key material).

2) For runtime telemetry: indicate the retention window and a 5-line masked excerpt showing a request flow that demonstrates tenant-scoped IDs (we only need anonymized examples).

3) Delivery: Sterling prefers an SFTP upload to their artifact intake (they will provide credentials after a PO/engagement letter). If you can provide a pre-signed Drive link as a fallback, include that in the bundle email.

If you can confirm we will schedule the walkthrough on Thu 2026-06-11 09:30 PT.

—Marco
Security Consultant, SecPartners
